protocol.source: User-provided Goose Goose Duck recording; private local path is not recorded here
limitations: Known-source recovery within +/-3 seconds is not recall of every appearance of an object.
Game backgrounds, UI and character appearances repeat; matches outside the source interval may still look similar. Inspect returned frames rather than declaring all such cases false identities.
If a query is exactly an indexed frame, retain it in the audit but exclude it from held-out query counts.
Foreign references are rejection probes, not fully annotated absence ground truth for the entire 2h11m video.
One source video and repeated crops are correlated; no general product accuracy or independent-query confidence interval claim.

baseline: Uniform baselines are anchor subsets of the same newly encoded index; no live library mutation
